entities.name: Query MutS protein
observations: 768 aa bacterial protein with five Pfam MutS domains: MutS_I positions 7-118, MutS_II 127-252, MutS_III 270-558, MutS_IV 427-518, and MutS_V 612-766.

Sequence analysis found 100% identity and full query coverage to reviewed Parabacteroides distasonis MutS reference A6LG92; the reference is 870 aa and has a shorter/longer coverage discrepancy in the aligned target.
Related reviewed Bacteroides fragilis MutS proteins show 79.6% identity over about 99% query coverage.
Predicted molecular weight is 86.73 kDa and theoretical pI is 5.94.

Likely cytosolic DNA mismatch-repair protein that recognizes mismatched or damaged DNA and has weak ATPase activity; this is supported by close reviewed homologs rather than a direct biochemical assay on the query sequence.

entities.name: DNA mismatch repair
observations: Reviewed MutS homologs assign this protein to GO:0006298 DNA mismatch repair, including mismatch/damaged-DNA binding and ATP-dependent DNA damage sensor activity.
MutS is the mismatch-recognition and ATP-regulated signaling component of the bacterial mismatch-repair pathway; downstream repair proteins are not established from this sequence alone.
